meta.title: Let's Watch — random movie & TV show picker
meta.description: Pick a movie or show in one tap. With no filters the draw comes straight from the IMDb Top 250 — or filter by streaming service, genre and decade.

header.kicker: Movies and shows in the draw
header.intro: Tired of spending half an hour just picking something to watch? With no filters, the draw comes straight from the IMDb Top 250 — or filter by streaming service, genre and decade.

filters.needsLive: Filtering by service requires live TMDb data.

stage.idleTriple: Draw 3 options and pick yours from
stage.chooseOne: Tap to pick one of the options:

items.q: Where do the drawn movies come from?
items.a: With no filters, the draw uses the IMDb Top 250 list (250 titles) mirrored on TMDb. When you filter by streaming service, titles come from that service's catalog in your region, sorted by rating.

items.q: Can I draw TV shows too?
items.a: Yes. Switch between Movies and TV shows at the top; shows use TMDb's top rated and popular rankings.

items.q: How do I filter by service, genre or decade?
items.a: Pick a service under "Where to watch" and narrow it down by genre and decade. The "Clear filters" button returns to the IMDb Top 250.

items.q: Can I see 3 options instead of 1?
items.a: Yes. In "Pick from 3" mode the draw returns three titles and you decide between them.
